title: Evaluation of a valid bit source
statement: Let $x$ be a finite Boolean list, let $n,w,i$ be natural numbers, and let $s$ be a bit source valid for input length $n$, block width $w$, and instruction index $i$. If two lists of previously computed Boolean blocks agree at every index $i'<i$, then evaluating $s$ using either list gives the same Boolean value.
hypotheses_covered: Agreement of the two block lists at every index $i'<i$
